page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, resulting in 32 vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge in the average performance tier across multiple categories. In CPU-intensive tests, the instance achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0. Memory performance tests show a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and a write bandwidth of 48.22 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the instance processed 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. LLM inference benchmarks using a 7B model recorded 45.98 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 12.4 tokens/sec for text generation.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention, which supports predictable execution times. However, the complete absence of local storage requires reliance on external network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute resources, this instance is suitable for workloads such as database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
